args.body:
label: bug
file: src/components/UploadForm.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

In src/components/UploadForm.tsx, the file input's onChange handler sets the file but leaves the old problem state intact, so the error message persists until the user submits again. Clearing the problem state (setProblem(null)) in the file input's onChange handler when a new file is chosen resolves this issue.
